Design a process that performs the following data preprocessing steps on the data a. Retrieve the cars.csv data set to the design area . b. Set the number of bins as 6. d. Use z-score normalization to standardize the values of the weight wt attribute on. e. Discretize the qsec attribute by using the Discretize by Binning operator. Set the number of bins as 4. f. Write the preprocessed data set to Excel file us
